en: Black‑and‑white view of a newly built housing estate with simple three‑storey apartment blocks arranged around an open, still‑undeveloped grassy area where many children are playing. The buildings have steep tiled roofs with multiple chimneys and regularly spaced rectangular windows. In the distance a church with a tall, pointed spire rises above the roofs, and there is a curved paved street with very little traffic. A small white number, apparently a catalog or negative number, is handwritten in the lower left corner.
